scenes.title: Real *sprite sheets*
scenes.caption: not a video, the actual app

caption:
Wisp's web page runs the real exported sprite sheets, the same frames the Raspberry Pi plays.

Keys 1-6 switch states, M fakes the mouth, B forces a blink.

Go break it. Link in bio.
